Align the expected error with the parser's message.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle null patient and tag entries during startup
commitResults.messageBody:
Null entries in saved patient or tag arrays throw an uncaught
NullPointerException and bypass startup backup-and-warning recovery.

Reject these entries with validation errors so the existing recovery
path preserves the invalid data and informs the user.

Add storage and startup regression tests for both cases, and document
the recovery behavior and manual verification steps.

Validation: ./gradlew check coverage passes with 967 tests.

Fixes AY2627S1-CS2103T-T09-4/tp#278

commitResults.messageTitle: Simplify patient fields in the User Guide
commitResults.messageBody:
Repeated health-field rules make add, edit, and view harder to scan.
Some examples also imply an invalid empty visit date or an unnecessary
manual refresh after editing.

Consolidate optional-field rules and examples into tables, shorten the
panel description, and correct command and display wording. Keep the
validation rules and distinctions between unrecorded and explicit
values.

Simplify Quick start and document the doc.jar launch command.

Fixes AY2627S1-CS2103T-T09-4/tp#281

commitResults.messageTitle: Clarify empty-tag display in the User Guide
commitResults.messageBody:
The optional-field summary implies that the Tags row disappears when
no tags are recorded, although the details panel keeps it visible.

Document the Tags row as an exception to the hiding rule.

commitResults.messageTitle: Test loading patients with empty tags
commitResults.messageBody:
The null-entry storage tests cover rejected tags but do not explicitly
assert that an empty tag array remains valid.

Add a regression test that loads a patient with empty tags, retains the
patient, and leaves the JSON file unchanged.
